verdict.line: You lose the fight if you tunnel a W engage before he's used Decisive Strike (Q) or if you sit below ~40% HP once he hits level 6 with Ignite up, but you win from level 9 onward once Eclipse comes online and turns the measured 51.6% head-to-head (620 games) into a clean duel.

brief.thesis: Garen wins the ability-lockout window: his Q (Decisive Strike) silence turns off your W (Infernal Chains) and R (World Ender) engage tools right as his E (Judgment) attack-speed steroid and passive Perseverance regen let him win short trades and heal it back. Once you have a full Q (The Darkin Blade) rank and Eclipse, your dash-reset damage and Deathbringer Stance procs out-scale his kit inside a single extended fight — which is exactly why Aatrox sits at 51.6% into Garen over 620 games despite only a 49.6% baseline top-lane winrate.

theirWindow.when: his Q is up and he's untouched 9s+
theirWindow.what: If his Q (Decisive Strike) is available he can silence your W/R the instant you commit, then free-cast E (Judgment) into empowered autos while Perseverance ticks him back to full — don't engage into an available Q, and if he's gone 9+ seconds without taking damage, poke him with an auto or ranged Q edge before he tops off.

yourWindow.when: his Q is on cooldown or whiffed
yourWindow.what: Once Decisive Strike is down he has no silence and no gap-closer, so land W (Infernal Chains) first to root him, then dump your Q chain and a Deathbringer Stance-empowered auto — this is the only window where your full combo goes off uninterrupted.

start.why: The extra AD and sustain (51.6% WR, 79.1% pick over 659 games) let you match his passive Perseverance regen in early poke exchanges instead of losing the war of attrition.

boots.why: 77.1% pick at 52.4% WR — flat physical damage reduction blunts his auto-attack-heavy E (Judgment) steroid and Decisive Strike bonus-damage autos.

core.why: The proc shield and burst damage line up with your W-root-into-Q-chain combo and let you punch through Courage's (W) damage reduction shield during your level 9-12 spike.
Its on-hit shield and healing extend exactly the kind of prolonged trade where you out-value his short burst windows.
Converts a chunk of his sustained physical DPS into a delayed DoT you can heal through with Umbral Dash (E), turning close fights in your favor by mid-game.

situational.when: you're already ahead and want to shred his armor for a faster snowball (58.3% WR path, 36 games)
he's building toward a level-6+ Ignite/Demacian Justice all-in and you need the anti-burst shield
you're stomping lane and want to compound cooldowns and damage further (75.9% WR, small 29-game sample)

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking adaptive force and healing over an extended fight is how you out-sustain Perseverance and out-damage him once the fight runs past his burst window.

summoners.why: 77.2% pick at 51.5% WR — Ignite matches his own Ignite/Demacian Justice execute threat and denies his healing in all-ins, while Flash covers a missed Infernal Chains or a needed disengage before his level-6 burst.

playing.title: Bait Decisive Strike First
playing.detail: Don't throw W (Infernal Chains) into an available Q — walk up so he wastes Decisive Strike on you or a minion, then engage in the ~8-9s window it's down, when he has no silence and no gap-closer.

playing.title: Poke His Regen Windows
playing.detail: Per the matchup data, hit him with a ranged Q edge or auto whenever your abilities are up and he's gone several seconds untouched — this keeps Perseverance from ever fully triggering.

playing.title: Respect Level 6 Executes
playing.detail: Once he hits 6, don't sit below ~40% HP in range — Demacian Justice (R) combined with Ignite is a real kill threat even through Sterak's Gage before you have it built.

playing.title: Root Before You Commit
playing.detail: Land W (Infernal Chains) before dumping Q charges; without the root his E (Judgment) attack speed and Q bonus-damage auto win the trade back.

playing.title: Time Your Eclipse Spike
playing.detail: Look for your first all-in right after completing Eclipse around level 6-7 — the proc cuts through Courage's (W) shield and marks the start of your favored window.

playing.title: Duel Him Late Without Fear
playing.detail: By level 13+, Death's Dance's damage deferral and Sterak's Gage's anti-burst shield mean you can take a straight 1v1 even if he's ahead on tempo.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample figures are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade patterns, cooldown timings, and level-by-level read are my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Engage Garen whenever your abilities come off cooldown to prevent his (P) from activating. After reaching level 6, be careful of being killed by his Ignite – Demacian Justice (R).
